}}'''Delora''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Shiande]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Delora}}

==Appearance==
She has blond hair and blue eyes.

==Strength and Abilities==
Delora can [[channel]] quite strongly. In TWoTC her strength level is described as {{opsl|23}}, the same level of [[Verin]] and [[Merana]], which is a high ranking level among [[Aes Sedai]].

This strength is more than enough to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing.

==Activities==
She [[Travel]]s to [[Ghealdan]] with [[Perrin Aybara]] to keep an eye out on [[Seonid Traighan]] and [[Masuri Sokawa]].

In the making of ''[[Mah'alleinir]]'' by Perrin the forger is helped with the [[One Power]] provided by [[Neald]], [[Grady]] and all six the Wise Ones in his camp.

Later it can be assumed that she stays along [[Edarra]] with Perrin's forces in the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Last Battle]] and then she fights in their campaigns.
